secrets.name: DISCORD_TOKEN
secrets.description: Discord bot token from the Discord Developer Portal (Bot > Token)

secrets.name: DISCORD_GUILD_ID
secrets.description: Discord server (guild) ID to sync slash commands to (optional, for instant command registration)

secrets.name: SPOTIPY_CLIENT_ID
secrets.description: Spotify app client ID from the Spotify Developer Dashboard (optional, for Spotify URL resolution)

secrets.name: SPOTIPY_CLIENT_SECRET
secrets.description: Spotify app client secret from the Spotify Developer Dashboard (optional, for Spotify URL resolution)

secrets.name: TIKHUB_API_TOKEN
secrets.description: TikHub API token from https://user.tikhub.io/ (optional, for TikTok audio download)

secrets.name: YOUTUBE_COOKIES_B64
secrets.description: Base64-encoded Netscape cookies.txt for YouTube auth — export from browser with a cookies extension, then base64 encode (optional, needed if YouTube blocks client rotation)
